ml_1m.note: val_equals_test_item counts users whose held-out validation and test events name the SAME item, so the head is fitted on the target it is later scored against. test_item_seen_in_train counts users whose test item was already consumed in training, in which case mask_seen removes it from every candidate set and its payoff is zero for every coalition.
